proposal.rationale: The requirement to make the network faster can be interpreted in several ways. One common approach is to reduce latency by optimizing routing and ensuring efficient data flow. Given the constraints, we will focus on configuring static routes to ensure that traffic between the client (10.0.1.0/24) and server (10.0.2.0/24) networks uses the transit link (10.0.12.0/30) efficiently.
